problem_statement: On an ARM64 MMU platform (Cortex-A53), the shared-multi-heap test must declare its DT memory regions using the new devicetree-based ARM64 memory attributes (DT_MEM_ARM64_MMU_NORMAL for cacheable, DT_MEM_ARM64_MMU_NORMAL_NC for non-cacheable) and have those regions mapped through the MMU at compile time, instead of the old ARM MPU attributes (DT_MEM_ARM(ATTR_MPU_RAM)). The shared-multi-heap library must allocate cacheable and non-cacheable chunks into the correct DT-described regions, and the build must succeed using the ARM64 memory-attribute bindings and a sufficient CONFIG_MAX_XLAT_TABLES to map the regions.

verification.reason: The statement gives the key macro names and the compile-time mapping behaviour, but omits the exact header path the test includes and the composable-bitmask encoding convention (non-cacheable = 0, cacheable sets DT_MEM_CACHEABLE), which are public interface details the agent needs to produce a correct header.

problems.detail: The test overlay includes <zephyr/dt-bindings/memory-attr/memory-attr-arm64.h> and the agent must create this header at that exact path; the statement only says 'ARM64 memory-attribute bindings' without giving the header path.

The statement names DT_MEM_ARM64_MMU_NORMAL and DT_MEM_ARM64_MMU_NORMAL_NC but does not state that the attributes follow a composable bitmask design where non-cacheable is 0 (no bits) and cacheable is DT_MEM_CACHEABLE | DT_MEM_ARM64(ATTR_ARM64_CACHE_WB); the agent could otherwise default to a one-hot scheme like the old ARM MPU attributes.

leak_check.leak_detail: The clause 'so that a region's cacheability can be derived as (DT_MEM_ATTR_GET(attr) & DT_MEM_CACHEABLE)' is code-like and closely mirrors the hidden test's attribute conversion. The macro bit semantics themselves are an allowed interface property, but this phrasing hints at implementation more than necessary.
leak_check.suggested_statement: On an ARM64 MMU platform (Cortex-A53), the shared-multi-heap test must declare its DT memory regions using the new devicetree-based ARM64 memory attributes defined in zephyr/dt-bindings/memory-attr/memory-attr-arm64.h (DT_MEM_ARM64_MMU_NORMAL for cacheable, DT_MEM_ARM64_MMU_NORMAL_NC for non-cacheable) and have those regions mapped through the MMU at compile time, instead of the old ARM MPU attributes (DT_MEM_ARM(ATTR_MPU_RAM)). The cacheable attribute is represented by the DT_MEM_CACHEABLE bit: DT_MEM_ARM64_MMU_NORMAL must set this bit and DT_MEM_ARM64_MMU_NORMAL_NC must not. The shared-multi-heap library must allocate cacheable and non-cacheable chunks into the correct DT-described regions, and the build must succeed using the ARM64 memory-attribute bindings and CONFIG_MAX_XLAT_TABLES=16 to map the regions.
